findings.summary: MochiMood.happyTears is defined and mapped to assets/mochi/happy-tears.svg but has no call site anywhere in the app — the asset path is untested. Either wire it in or remove the enum value and comment.

GoogleFonts.spaceMono(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600) is used in edit_category_sheet.dart:102, add_recurring_sheet.dart:117+163, add_goal_sheet.dart:107. Space Mono ships only Regular (400) and Bold (700); w600 silently falls back to 400, rendering currency prefix labels lighter than intended. Pre-existing from b2e0499, unaddressed in this commit. Change to FontWeight.w700 or FontWeight.normal.

main_navigation_screen.dart:44 uses AC.primary (#231D30) for the nav bar drop shadow. In the new dark palette AC.primary is nearly identical to AC.bg (#1A1625), making the shadow invisible and flattening the floating pill in dark mode. The border was correctly migrated to AC.accent in this commit; the shadow should follow. Fix: BoxShadow(color: AC.accent.withValues(alpha: 0.2), ...).
